lines.text: ADDENDA.
The student is requested to mark the following Addenda in the proper places.
Page 27. col. 1, before Art. אוּשׁ add this article:
אוֹרְנָה, see אֲרַוְנָה.
“ 32. “ 2, l. 3 from bott. for ‘q. d. etc.’ read: lit. soothes it, keeps it within
himself.
“ 38. “ 1, l. 25 sq. read: kśatrapa, pr. protector (representative) of the regal
power, viceroy; Lassen in Zeitschr. f. d. Morgenl. VI. p. 18.
“ 38. “ 1, l. 6 from bott. read: khysyârsâ, rex pius, Lassen in Zeitschr. f. d.
Morgenl. VI. p. 124. It is certain, etc.
“ 66. “ 2, l. 3 from bott. after to say; add: but see in זָמַר II. Note. Comp.
“ 69. “ 2, l. 3, add at the end: See more in r. פָּרַק.
“ 84. “ 1, l. 15, after 166, add: Irby and Mangles p. 478.
“ 104. “ 2, bott. after [41]. add: In v. 6 [21] written יְאָתְרַי q. v.
“ 144. “ 1, l. 22, for come among us, read: fall upon us round about.
“ 150. “ 1, l. 20, for wounded, read: hurt, broken;
“ 151. “ 1, l. 2, for Keri, read: Kethibh;
“ 170. “ 1, l. 16 from bott. dele: Nah. 2, 3.
“ 183. “ 1, l. 3 from bott. add: See r. שָׁפֵל Hiph. p. 1102.
“ 191. “ 2, after Art. גִּלֹנִי add this article:
גִּינַת (garden, r. גָּנַן) Ginath, pr. n. m. 1 K. 16, 21. 22.
“ 211. “ 1, l. 12, read: to speak; see more in r. זָמַר II. Note.
“ 216. “ 2, before Art. הוֹדָה add this article:
דּוּדָאִים, see in דּוּדַי.
“ 222. “ 2, l. 4 from bott. after other. add: But see in r. הָמַךְ no. 1.
“ 285. “ 2, l. 11 from bott. add: See Biblioth. Sac. 1848, p. 684.
“ 333. “ 1, l. 7 from bott. after m. add: emphat. חַסְפָּא,
“ 371. “ 1, l. 15 from bott. dele: Zech. 10, 11.
“ “ “ 1, l. 13 from bott. read: In two places only it is spoken of the Eu-
phrates, Zech. 10, 11. Dan. 12, 5. 6. 7.
“ 484. “ 1, l. 20, before 1. add: also כְּפֹר Job 38, 29.
“ 486. “ 1, before Art. כְּפִרִים add this article:
כְּפֹר, see כְּפוֹר.
“ 549. “ 2, l. 3, end of the line, add: Russell’s Aleppo I. p. 76. Biblioth. Sac.
“ 664. “ 1, l. 16 from bott. before d) add: Also of the Holy Land, Jer. 2, 7.
“ 773. “ 2, before Art. עֵינַיִם add this article:
עַיִן Chald. m. constr. עֵין; plur. עַיְנִין, constr. עַיְנֵי; an eye, i. q.
“ 1016. “ 2, after Art. שָׂפָם add this article:
שְׁפָמוֹת, see שִׂפְמוֹת.

line_status.note: The diacritic over the italic s in "kśatrapa" is a single acute stroke (ś), not a caron (š); everything else is identical in A and B and matches the print.

The root is printed פָּרַק (pe with dagesh, not tsade) — Reading A's צָדַק is wrong; but the print has the period-style spaces before the colon after "end" and before the final period, which Reading B drops.

The Hebrew vowels are as in B: shewa under yod, qamets under aleph, shewa under tav, patah under resh (יְאָתְרַי, Jeaterai, 1 Chr 6:6 [21], variant of Ethni v. 26 [41]); A's segol under yod and shewa under aleph are wrong. But B drops the printed space before the colon ("add :"), which A has; so neither is exact.

The printed Hebrew is the short four-letter word גִּלֹנִי (gimel-dagesh-hiriq, lamed-holem, nun-hiriq, yod) — the gentilic "Gilonite", which is indeed the article on p. 191. Reading B's גִּלְיֹנִים inserts a yod and final mem that are not printed; there is no plene yod after lamed and no mem.

Both Hebrew words begin with dalet bearing a dagesh followed by vav with shureq (דּוּ), not he with holem-vav (הוֹ) as in Reading B; the flat-topped dalet with its inner dot is clear, and the context (an article on mandrakes to be inserted before דּוֹדָה, referring to דּוּדַי) confirms it. The final word has patah under the second dalet and yod (דּוּדַי), not hiriq and no vav as in B.

Under the kaf the print shows two vertically stacked dots (shva), not a patach bar, and under the pe a single dot (hiriq), not a shva; the word is defective כְּפִרִים with no yod after pe. Reading A matches; B's כַּפְרִים is wrong.

The Hebrew word is printed שָׂפָם: the shin carries a sin dot (upper left) and a qamets beneath, not a shin dot with qubbuts as in Reading A. Pe has dagesh + qamets, final mem. Matches Gesenius p. 1016 שָׂפָם "moustache".

First word has shin dot (upper right) with shewa under shin and qamets under pe; second word has sin dot (upper left) with hireq under sin and shewa under pe. Reading B swaps the vocalisations of the two words.
